# laravelforge_server_php_version (Resource)

Installs and manages a PHP version on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to install the PHP version on.
- `version` (String) PHP version key to install (e.g. `php82`). Create-only.

### Optional

- `cli_default` (Boolean) Whether to make this the default CLI PHP version on install. Applied at create time only.
- `site_default` (Boolean) Whether to make this the default site PHP version on install. Applied at create time only.

### Read-Only

- `binary_name` (String) PHP binary name (e.g. `php82`).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the installed PHP version.
- `status` (String) Installation status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
